en: A decorative German birthday postcard. The front shows a small painted view of a yellow-walled gatehouse with red roof framed by a garland of red roses on a tan background. Below is printed and handwritten German greeting text. The reverse has multilingual 'Carte postale – Post card' header, German handwriting, and a red 10 Pfennig 'Deutsches Reich' stamp with a Danzig postmark, addressed to Malmö, Sweden.
